results.title: Hungarian transport minister: Traffic on Budapest - Belgrade high speed railway should be launched in December
results.description: Hungarian Transport Minister David Vitezy has stated that that the ETCS automatic train control system was successfully tested on the new railway line running.

results.title: Xiaomi's next midrange phone could feature the Dimensity 9500s and massive 10,000mAh-plus battery
results.description: Tipster Digital Chat Station claims the Redmi Turbo 6 Max will use MediaTek’s Dimensity 9500s and a battery above 10,000mAh, up from the 9,000mAh cell in the Turbo 5 Max. Earlier leaks point to a flat 7-inch 2K OLED panel, IP68 and IP69 protection and a January launch.

results.title: As Russia steps up attacks on Ukrainian data centers, could Ukraine soon be offline?
results.description: As Russia targets Ukraine's data centers more and more, experts say the country's internet system is too robust to shut down entirely. However, services could become more expensive.
